convention.anchor: Empty at the tile body centre (tile units, 1 unit = 28 mm), rotation = the tile pose (row-major 3x3).
convention.faceQuadLocal: 12 floats: 4 corners TL, TR, BR, BL in anchor-local units (+x tile right, +y glyph top, +z out of the painted face), at z = +thickness/2, inside the bevel inset.
convention.faceQuadWorld: the same 4 corners in world space.
convention.occupied: true when the anchor currently holds a reference tile; overflow/kan-extension anchors are false and carry a face quad without a body.
